summary: 100 ft International Derrick tower in Grenada County, MS, listed by NHLR in July 2022 as Kincaid; current condition not confirmed; no build date or history found. A Forest Lookouts entry called Gore Springs is not linked to it.

events.note: Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register July 19, 2022 as US 1685, MS 44; nominated by Jason Johns
Register records a site visit noted as 2/5/22

evidence.supports: Site is in Grenada County, Mississippi
Build date is listed as unknown
Administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission
Forest Lookouts lists a Gore Springs tower in the Mississippi section
Forest Lookouts places the Gore Springs entry in Grenada County

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register calls the tower Kincaid. The Forest Lookouts index lists a Grenada County entry called Gore Springs. Neither source links the two names, so the story does not treat them as one tower.

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR entry and the Forest Lookouts index (name and county only) were usable. The register gives a site visit noted as 2/5/22 and no narrative beyond the tower type. Two WebSearch queries found only a 1911 map mention of Kincaid and an unrelated 2005 antenna structure at Gore Springs, which are not used. A state Public Lands list (sos.ms.gov, July 2020) includes a 'Grenada Tower Site' that may or may not be this tower; not used because the list does not name the tower. The Gore Springs = Kincaid link is not supported: the register does not mention Gore Springs and the Gore Springs page does not mention Kincaid, so the story makes no such claim. height_m is converted from the register's 100 ft. No access key set. No staffing, fire or fate information found. No photos found.
